description: This file defines internal data structures and function declarations related to logging modules and levels within the XR voice SDK. It includes conditional declarations based on the VSDK_VENDOR_XLOG macro, suggesting it's part of internal logging infrastructure.

methods.name: xlog_vd_module_str_to_index

methods.name: xlog_vd_level_str_to_num

methods.name: xlog_mw_module_str_to_index

methods.name: xlog_mw_level_str_to_num
